create_autodecoder_embeddings: create an Autodecoder instance that maps string or integer keys to optimizable embedding vectors
forward_autodecoder_codes: forward a batch of string keys or long tensor indices through the Autodecoder to get embedding codes
calculate_squared_encoding_norm: calculate the mean squared norm of the Autodecoder embedding weights for regularization
load_autodecoder_state: load an Autodecoder state dict that includes the key map for string-to-id mappings
build_key_map: build a key map dictionary that assigns incremental integer IDs to string keys
